shortDescription: This module allow to manage component templates of an Elasticsearch installation

options.name: api_endpoint
options.description: The url used to connect with elasticsearch service

options.name: component_templates
options.description: This is a key value dictionary containing as key the name of the component template and as value the specifications The allowed keys for the subdictionary are: I(_meta) and/or I(template). The template key allow only three keys: I(settings), I(mapping) and I(aliases).

options.name: password
options.description: The password used to connect with elasticsearch service

options.name: ssl_verify
options.description: Choose to verify the ssl certificate or not

options.name: user
options.description: The user used to connect with elasticsearch service
